ex.s: SoFi Stadium requires you to park strictly in your assigned zone, and guests must enter through the exact gate indicated on their color-coded digital parking pass.
ex.t: SoFi体育场要求你严格在指定区域停车，并且宾客必须通过其彩色编码电子停车证上标明的确切入口进入。

ex.s: For those wishing to park near friends, all vehicles must have passes for the same zone and arrive together — spaces cannot be saved.
ex.t: 对于想把车停在朋友附近的人，所有车辆必须持有同一区域的停车证并同时到达——车位不能预留。

ex.s: • Writing Submission: Submissions must be a maximum of 250 words.
ex.t: • 文字类提交：提交内容最多250词。

ex.s: Computer programming is a must for scientists.
ex.t: 计算机编程对科学家来说是必备技能。

ex.s: Bordering the square, the Ludlow Castle is a “must explore” medieval stronghold.
ex.t: 城堡Ludlow紧邻广场，是一座“必探”的中世纪要塞。

ex.s: You must leave right now!” he called out, holding the branch with both hands.
ex.t: “你必须现在就离开！”他双手抓着树枝喊道。

ex.s: Groups of five or more require special arrangements and must be confirmed in advance.
ex.t: 五人及以上的团体需要特别安排，并须提前确认。

ex.s: Volunteers under the age of 18 must have the parent/guardian approval section signed.
ex.t: 未满18岁的志愿者必须由家长/监护人签字批准。

ex.s: She explains we are at a “tipping point” in history and must act now to prevent an extinction-level event for humanity.
ex.t: 她解释说，我们正处于历史上的一个“临界点”，必须立刻行动，以防人类遭遇灭绝级事件。

ex.s: Books must be returned within a month.
ex.t: 图书必须在一个月内归还。

ex.s: Direct observation is a must for scientific research.
ex.t: 5. — 迈克下周将宣布他从职业足球退役。

ex.s: Social benefits are accompanied by social demands: we must get along, but not put up with too much.
ex.t: 社会利益伴随着社会要求：我们必须与人相处，但不能过分忍让。

ex.s: To serve its function, a book must be activated by a user: the cover opened, the pages parted, the contents reviewed, perhaps notes written down or words underlined.
ex.t: 为了发挥其功能，一本书必须由使用者来激活：打开封面，翻开书页，浏览内容，也许还要写下笔记或划出字句。

ex.s: If we want to reconstruct what was actually going on that day, the shield must be questioned and interpreted as deeply and strictly as the written reports.
ex.t: 如果我们想重建当天实际发生的事情,就必须对盾牌提出质疑,并把它解释为与书面报告一样深刻和严格。

ex.s: If you choose to drop a course you must follow the UCLA procedures for removing it from your schedule.
ex.t: 如果你选择退一门课，你必须遵循UCLA将其从你的课表中移除的程序。

ex.s: Class activities will vary from day to day, but students must be ready to complete short in-class writings or tests drawn directly from assigned readings or notes from the previous class' lecture/discussion, so it is important to take careful notes during class.
ex.t: 课堂活动每天不同，但学生必须准备好完成直接取自指定阅读或上节课讲座/讨论笔记的简短课堂写作或测试，所以课堂上认真记笔记很重要。

ex.s: Registration must be made at least two weeks in advance.
ex.t: 必须至少提前两周注册。

ex.s: They must be led by teachers.
ex.t: 他们必须由老师带领。

ex.s: They must have ID cards with them.
ex.t: 他们必须携带身份证件。

ex.s: It's a call she must heed alone, though.
ex.t: 不过，这是她必须独自听从的召唤。

ex.s: First, researchers need to identify all the players in that system; second, they must work out how they relate to each other; and third, they need to understand and quantify the impact of those relationships on each other and on those outside the system.
ex.t: 首先，研究人员需要识别该系统中的所有参与者；其次，他们必须弄清楚彼此之间的关系；第三，他们需要理解和量化这些关系对彼此以及对系统外各方的影响。

ex.s: More researchers, policymakers and representatives from the food industry must learn to look beyond their direct lines of responsibility and adopt a systems approach.
ex.t: 更多研究者、政策制定者和食品行业代表必须学会超越其直接责任范围，并采用系统方法。

ex.s: There are different levels of exercises for different age groups and we must do them according to our own health and age.
ex.t: 有针对不同年龄组的不同强度练习，我们必须根据自己的健康和年龄来做。

ex.s: Under this Act, all waterfowl hunters 16 years of age and over must annually purchase and carry a Federal Duck Stamp.
ex.t: 根据该法案，所有16岁及以上的水禽猎人每年必须购买并携带一张联邦鸭票。

ex.s: Seeing the world is a must for children.
ex.t: 看世界对孩子是必要的。

ex.s: One of the ground rules of the swap should be that everyone must try on the clothes before they take them—things always look different when you put them on.
ex.t: 衣物交换的基本规则之一应该是：每个人在拿走衣服之前必须试穿——衣服穿在身上看起来总是不一样的。

ex.s: Actually, a true eco-friendly trip must meet the following principles:
ex.t: 实际上，一次真正环保的旅行必须符合以下原则：

ex.s: “The technologist must build up a story with the patient," Ms L'Ecuyer said.
ex.t: “技师必须和患者一起构建出一个故事，”勒居耶女士说。

ex.s: Applicants in technical assignments must have reached the last year of their studies in a technical institution．
ex.t: 技术岗位的申请人必须已进入技术院校学习的最后一年。

ex.s: You must be at least 20 years old．
ex.t: 你必须至少年满20岁．

ex.s: You must have an excellent knowledge of office-related software．
ex.t: 你必须非常精通办公相关软件。

ex.s: Travel：You must arrange and finance your travel to and from the location where you will do your internship．
ex.t: 旅行：你必须安排并支付往返实习地点的旅行费用．

ex.s: Medical certificate：You must provide a medical certificate indicating you are fit to work．
ex.t: 体检证明：你必须提供一份表明你身体状况适合工作的体检证明。

ex.s: Hundreds of scientists, writers and academics sounded a warning to humanity in an open letter published last December: Policymakers and the rest of us must engage openly with the risk of global collapse.
ex.t: 数百名科学家、作家和学者去年12月在发表的一封公开信中向人类发出警告：政策制定者和我们所有人都必须公开面对全球崩溃的风险。

ex.s: Here are some principles you must master.
ex.t: 这里有一些你必须掌握的原则。

ex.s: Museums must compete     45    people’s spare time and money with other amusements.
ex.t: 博物馆必须与其他娱乐活动竞争45个人的空余时间和金钱。

ex.s: To survive in the forest, animals must climb, jump or fly across the gaps.
ex.t: 为了在森林中生存，动物们必须爬过、跳过或飞越这些空隙。

ex.s: All customers travelling on TransLink services must be in possession of a valid ticket before boarding.
ex.t: 所有乘坐TransLink服务的顾客在登机前必须持有有效的车票.

ex.s: They must run long distances.
ex.t: 它们必须跑很远的距离。

ex.s: One must know how on object was made in order to preserve it.
ex.t: 人们必须了解一件物品是如何制作的才能保护它。

ex.s: You must keep these points in mind while setting your goals.
ex.t: 设定目标时你必须记住这些要点。

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式触动着人们的生活。

ex.s: Documentary： A visual presentation （such as a video， slide show， or computer project） no more than 10 minutes long． A desktop computer， screen， projector， and loudspeakers will be available． Students must provide their presentations on CDs before Friday， March 23．
ex.t: 纪录片：一种视觉展示（如视频、幻灯片或电脑作品），时长不超过10分钟。将提供台式电脑、屏幕、投影仪和扬声器。学生必须在3月23日星期五之前将展示内容刻录在CD上提交。

ex.s: One study found that a cotton bag must be used at least 131 times to be better for the planet than plastic.
ex.t: 一项研究发现，一个棉布袋必须至少使用131次，才比塑料袋对环境更有利。

ex.t: A．should leaveB．must have left

ex.s: But they must realize that the employment market is about how an employee will be a good fit for a company, not the other way around.
ex.t: 但他们必须意识到，就业市场关乎员工如何契合公司，而非相反。

ex.s: Unfortunately, you must carry the necessary equipment with you, since it’s all but impossible to find natural substitutes.
ex.t: 遗憾的是，你必须随身携带必要的设备，因为几乎不可能找到天然的替代品。

ex.s: The low point of the sheet must be centered directly over, and no more than three inches above, the cup.
ex.t: 塑料布的最低点必须正好对准杯子中心，且高出杯子不超过三英寸。

ex.s: I must say that I have certainly come to enjoy camping.
ex.t: 我必须说我确实已经开始喜欢露营了。

ex.s: You must be named Elizabeth Gallahgher and have a Candian 42     .
ex.t: 你必须名叫伊丽莎白·加拉赫，并且持有一本加拿大护照。

ex.s: His father said that the cat must be sick.
ex.t: 他的爸爸说这只猫肯定是病了。

ex.s: Alia knew that if the books were to be safe, they must be  53  again while the city was  54  .
ex.t: 阿莉亚知道，如果要让书安全，就必须在城市____54____时再次____53____。

ex.s: But if governments don’t want a data economy controlled by a few giants, they must act soon.
ex.t: 但如果政府不希望数据经济被少数巨头控制，就必须尽快行动。

ex.s: Then, they will introduce their supporting arguments with expressions such as We must remember that… and We can’t deny that… Student A: Turn to Page 83.
ex.t: 然后，他们会用“我们必须记住……”和“我们不能否认……”这样的表达引出支撑论点。学生A：翻到第83页。

ex.s: You must be careful of falling stones.
ex.t: 你必须小心掉下来的石头。

defs.def: （表示很可能或符合逻辑）一定

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: I read both definitions over again, trying to figure it out, but Miss Chevalier must have read my mind.
ex.t: 我把两个释义又读了一遍，试图弄明白，但谢瓦利埃小姐一定看穿了我的心思。

ex.s: The hot spring at the foot of the mountain is something you must try after the climb.
ex.t: 山脚下的温泉是你爬完山一定要试的。

ex.s: After a thorough   15   we determined that he must have left it at the fountain.
ex.t: 经过一番彻底的___15___，我们断定他一定是把它落在喷泉旁了。

ex.s: I must have always known reading was very important because the first memories I have as a child deal with books． There was not one night that I don't remember mom reading me a storybook by my bedside． I was extremely inspired by the elegant way the words sounded．
ex.t: 我一定一直都知道阅读非常重要，因为我童年最早的记忆都与书有关。没有哪个夜晚我不记得妈妈在床边给我读故事书。那些文字优雅的读音极大地启发了我。

ex.s: Then someone said, “She must have come to say goodbye.”
ex.t: 然后有人说："她一定是来道别的。"

ex.s: He must have been waiting there for quite a while!
ex.t: 他一定在那儿等了很久了！

ex.s: The man must have heard my  25  the night before.
ex.t: 这位男士一定听到了我25 前一天晚上的声音。

ex.s: I like eating frying tomatoes with eggs, and I thought it must to be easy to cook.
ex.t: 我喜欢吃西红柿炒鸡蛋，我以为这一定很容易做。

ex.s: 40     It must be true that sooner or later, everyone finds his or her way back to nature.
ex.t: 40     每个人迟早都会回归大自然，这一定是真的。

ex.s: You must have had some moments when you were disappointed.
ex.t: 你一定有过失望的时刻。

ex.s: Last week, I went to the butcher's and asked "Do you have pigs'ears?""No,"the butcher said, pulling at his own ears,"just these ordinary ones."He must have thought I was joking.
ex.t: 上周，我去肉铺问：“你们有猪耳朵吗？”“没有，”肉贩拉着自己的耳朵说，“只有这些普通的。”他一定以为我在开玩笑。
